scenario_type: cli_command
description: Discover components for Krkn-AI tests

### parameters

| name | variable | type | default | required | description |
| ---- | -------- | ---- | ------- | -------- | ----------- |
| skip-pod-name | SKIP_POD_NAME | string |  | false | Pod name to skip. Supports comma separated values with regex. |
| verbose | VERBOSE | string |  | false | Increase verbosity of output. |
| node-label | NODE_LABEL | string | .* | false | Node Label Keys(s) to filter. Supports Regex and comma separated values. |
| pod-label | POD_LABEL | string | .* | false | Pod Label Keys(s) to filter. Supports Regex and comma separated values. |
| namespace | NAMESPACE | string | .* | false | Namespace(s) to discover components in. Supports Regex and comma separated values. |
| output | OUTPUT | string | ./krkn-ai.yaml | false | Path to save config file. |
| kubeconfig | KUBECONFIG | string | (dynamic) | false | Path to cluster kubeconfig file. |

## scenario: run
scenario_type: cli_command
description: Run Krkn-AI tests

### parameters

| name | variable | type | default | required | description |
| ---- | -------- | ---- | ------- | -------- | ----------- |
| port | PORT | number | 8501 | false | Port to run Streamlit server on when monitoring is enabled. |
| monitoring | MONITORING | bool |  | false | Launch live monitoring dashboard in the background. |
| verbose | VERBOSE | string |  | false | Increase verbosity of output. |
| seed | SEED | number |  | false | Random seed for reproducible runs. Overrides seed in config file. |
| param | PARAM | string | [] | false | Additional parameters for config file in key=value format. |
| runner-type | RUNNER_TYPE | choice |  | false | Type of chaos engine to use. |
| format | FORMAT | choice | yaml | false | Format of the output file. |
| output | OUTPUT | string |  | false | Directory to save results. |
| config | CONFIG | string |  | false | Path to krkn-ai config file. |
| kubeconfig | KUBECONFIG | string | (dynamic) | false | Path to cluster kubeconfig file. Setting this will override value in config file. |
